name: Seattle University
description: Founded in 1891, Seattle University is a Jesuit, Catholic university located on a vibrant and green campus of 50 acres in the dynamic heart of Seattle, Washington. Our diverse and caring community is made up of more than 7,200 students enrolled in undergraduate and graduate programs within six schools and colleges. Experience personalized learning with faculty who care passionately about your success. Timestamps
